THE SALAD EDIT — EPISODE 1 🥗

CLASSIC CHICKEN CAESAR SALAD

This is your sign to eat more salad, but make it really, really good. 🥗

My classic chicken Caesar comes together in under 30 minutes, has 60g protein per serving and is completely meal-prep friendly. Basically, not a sad salad.

414 CALORIES | 60G PROTEIN | 15G CARBS | 11G FAT | 3G FIBRE

SERVES 3

INGREDIENTS

For the chicken:

450g chicken breast, cubed
1 tsp olive oil
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
1 tsp paprika
½ tsp oregano
½ tsp chilli powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

For the Caesar dressing:

250g Greek yogurt
20g finely grated Parmesan
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
2 garlic cloves, minced
Juice of ½ lemon
Salt + black pepper, to taste
Water, as needed

For the salad:

1 large head romaine lettuce, chopped
Extra Parmesan
Freshly cracked black pepper

METHOD

1. Marinate the chicken with olive oil, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, oregano, chilli powder, salt, pepper and lemon juice for 15–20 minutes.
2. Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken in a single layer and pan-fry for 8–10 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden and cooked through.
3. For the dressing, whisk together Greek yogurt, Parmesan, Dijon, Worcestershire sauce, garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Add water gradually until smooth and pourable.
4. Toss the romaine with the Caesar dressing. Top with the pan-fried chicken, extra Parmesan and freshly cracked black pepper.

PRO TIP: Get your pan properly hot and don’t overcrowd it. this gives the chicken those gorgeous golden edges. ✨

Save this for the next time you want a salad that actually feels like a meal. 🥗
